text: Tenderer must hold a valid NMSB 7310 certificate.
Tenderer must hold electrical contracting rights (sahkourakointioikeudet) of at least class S2.
Tenderer must have at least one reference project with a value of at least EUR 500,000.
Escalation procedure for unresolved faults must be addressed.
A method statement for installation works must be addressed.
Compliance of elevator servicing with regulations must be addressed.
Spare parts availability and delivery time must be addressed.
Servicing of fire-protection systems must be addressed.
Response time for emergency situations and the on-call arrangement (hataytilanteiden vasteaika ja paivystysjarjestely) must be addressed.
Handover of the asset register and documentation must be addressed.
An occupational safety plan (tyoturvallisuussuunnitelma) must be addressed.
Price indexation clause must be addressed.
Limitation of liability clause (vastuunrajoituslauseke) must be addressed.
Contract period and extension options (sopimuskausi ja jatko-optiot) must be addressed.
Contract termination conditions (sopimuksen irtisanomisehdot) must be addressed.
The warranty period for installed equipment is 24 months from acceptance (asennettujen laitteiden takuuaika on 24 kuukautta vastaanotosta).
CVs of key personnel must be enclosed with the tender.
An insurance certificate must be enclosed with the tender.
All prices must be quoted excluding VAT, in EUR.
Unit basis for maintenance pricing (per property vs. per square metre) must be stated as required.
Price must be stated as EUR/m2/year, not EUR/month.
Warranty period for installed equipment (asennettujen laitteiden takuuaika) must be addressed.
Periodic statutory inspections of electrical installations (sahkoasennusten maaraaikaistarkastukset) must be addressed.
Condition-monitoring data collection (kunnonvalvonnan tiedonkeruu) must be addressed.
Building automation system compatibility with BACnet/Modbus must be addressed.
Contractual penalty for shortfall against the service level (sopimussakko palvelutason alittuessa) must be addressed.
